Earth.energy_ref: Davies & Davies 2010 Solid Earth 1:5 (47 TW total; ~20 TW radiogenic); KamLAND 2011; lunar dissipation ~3.7 TW (Munk & Wunsch 1998)
Earth.mag_ref: geomagnetic field measured; paleointensity to >3.4 Ga (Tarduno et al. 2010 Science 327:1238)

Venus.energy_ref: no heat-flow measurement; models ~10-30 mW/m2 (e.g. O'Rourke & Korenaga 2015 Icarus 260:56); insolation 2613 W/m2 TOA
Venus.mag_ref: Phillips & Russell 1987; Zhang et al. induced magnetosphere

Mars.energy_ref: InSight HP3 thermal gradient -> ~21 mW/m2 (Plesa et al. 2021/2022); insolation 586 W/m2
Mars.mag_ref: Lillis et al. 2008 GRL 35:L14203; Vervelidou et al. 2017 JE005410; Acuna et al. 1999 Science 284:790

Moon.energy_ref: Apollo 15/17 heat flow 21 & 16 mW/m2 (Langseth et al. 1976); insolation 1361 W/m2

mag.dynamo_ev: paleo-remanence in Apollo samples (ended ~<1 Ga, timing debated)

Moon.mag_ref: Weiss & Tikoo 2014 Science 346:1246753; Mighani et al. 2020 Nat Astron 4:366

Mercury.energy_ref: no surface heat-flow measurement; insolation highly variable (perihelion ~14462 W/m2)

mag.intrinsic: ACTIVE weak dipole (~190 nT RM3 equatorial)

Mercury.mag_ref: Anderson et al. 2011 Science 333:1859; Johnson et al. 2012

Io.energy_ref: global heat flow ~1.5-3 W/m2, mean ~2.24 W/m2 -> ~9.3e13 W total (Davies 2007; Veeder et al. 2012 Icarus 219:701); tidal origin (Peale et al. 1979 Science 203:892)

Europa.energy_ref: tidal heating in ice shell + possible silicate tidal dissipation (models ~1e11-1e12 W); insolation ~50 W/m2
Europa.mag_ref: Kivelson et al. 2000 Science 289:1340 — induction ≠ intrinsic dynamo

Titan.energy_ref: insolation ~15 W/m2 TOA; radiogenic+tidal small; interior ocean inferred (Love k2~0.6)
Titan.mag_ref: Cassini magnetometer; Iess et al. 2012 Science 337:457 (k2 ocean evidence)
